**Finding submitted: deviation (LOL-CAP).**

Investigation summary:
- **§13.4 (p0207)** — the only aggregate cap: one-sided (M&I only), pegged to "payments made ... during the three (3) months prior to the event." That is both non-mutual and below the six-month walk-away floor.
- **§13.1 (p0198–p0204)** — mutual direct-damages-only regime with an expansive list of deemed direct damages; beneficial to us, not flagged.
- **§13.2 (p0205)** — mutual exclusion of indirect/incidental/punitive/special/consequential damages; already satisfies the preferred mutual-exclusion element.
- **§14.2 (p0219–p0220)** and **§17 (p0243–p0249)** — indemnities and confidentiality obligations exist but sit entirely inside the §13.4 cap; no carve-out language anywhere.
- **ACH provision (p0117)** — a service-specific liability floor limited to M&I's gross negligence/willful misconduct; not an aggregate cap, so not double-flagged.

Cure (fallback target, two surgical operations): the existing cap sentence becomes mutual and twelve months' fees, and one added sentence places indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct outside the cap. The one-year suit limitation and its collection carve-out were left verbatim, and the new sentence is anchored to "the first sentence of this Section 13.4" so the retained "foregoing limitation" reference remains unambiguous.
